posts.title: Setting Up Proxmox
posts.description: I’ve been dabbling with running my own home server for a few years. After my gaming pc started collecting dust for child reasons I wiped it and started experimenting with different Linux distros. posts.title: AI and the Expanding Market for Software Engineers
posts.description: Everyone seems convinced that AI is going to crater demand for software engineers. The logic is straightforward: AI writes code now, so companies will need fewer engineers, so the market shrinks. Supply up, demand down, salaries follow. I’m not so sure.
